holdings.name: Multi Commodity Exchange Of India Ltd

what_changed.text: MCX received a GST show cause notice on September 29, 2026 proposing 54.08 crore rupees in tax, 43.82 crore rupees in interest, and 5.41 crore rupees in penalty.
The company appointed Ramesh Varakhedkar as Chief Business Officer and reorganized key leadership roles in metals and strategy.
For the quarter ended June 2026, MCX reported net profit of 413 crore rupees on sales of 702 crore rupees.

holdings.why_it_matters: MCX is the fund's largest holding at 3.22% weight and was its top 3-month contributor, adding an estimated +0.636% to portfolio performance with a 19.76% return.

watch.text: Legal steps and liabilities arising from the 54.08 crore rupee GST show cause notice.

holdings.name: AU Small Finance Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: AU SFB reported provisional Q2 FY27 deposit growth of 28.6% to 1.70 lakh crore rupees and gross loan growth of 25.1%.
ICRA reaffirmed its AA rating, assigned AA to 100 crore rupees of infrastructure bonds, and revised the outlook to Positive.
Vinay Vaish was re-appointed as Head of Internal Audit for one year starting October 7, 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: With a 2.84% weight, the stock declined 8.40% over 3 months, acting as a drag on the fund's heavy 28.7% Financials allocation.

watch.text: Final audited Q2 FY27 earnings disclosures following the provisional business update.

holdings.name: The Federal Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: Federal Bank launched the Verto Resident Savings Account on October 7, 2026.
CARE reaffirmed the bank's issuer and bond ratings at AA+ Stable on October 9, 2026.
Net profit reached 1,302 crore rupees on revenue of 7,862 crore rupees for the quarter ended June 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: The bank represents 2.59% of the fund and remained flat over 3 months (+0.05%), despite maintaining a 1-year return of 59.16%.

watch.text: Board meeting and analyst call on October 16, 2026 to review Q2 FY27 financial results.

holdings.name: Info Edge (India) Ltd

what_changed.text: Info Edge reported that Q2 FY27 billings grew 12.8% to 822.3 crore rupees.
The company released its September 2026 Naukri JobSpeak report on October 1, 2026.
Net profit stood at 490 crore rupees on revenue of 881 crore rupees in the June 2026 quarter.

holdings.why_it_matters: Holding a 2.55% fund weight, the stock delivered a modest 1.24% return over 3 months, anchoring the fund's 9.5% Technology exposure.

watch.text: Segment billing momentum across recruitment and real estate platforms in the detailed Q2 report.

holdings.name: Fortis Healthcare Ltd

what_changed.text: The Supreme Court disposed of Fortis's SLP and permitted a forensic audit in the Daiichi dispute without imposing liability or penalties.
Northern TK Venture appealed a Tokyo District Court ruling to the Tokyo High Court on September 24, 2026.
Fortis executed 29-year agreements for a 400+ bed hospital in Delhi funded by a 567 crore rupee loan facility.

holdings.why_it_matters: At a 2.53% weight, Fortis was the fund's largest negative contributor over 3 months, subtracting an estimated -0.475% as the stock declined 18.78%.

watch.text: Developments from the Supreme Court-authorized forensic audit.
Regulatory scrutiny on hospital markups and cancer drug price caps.

holdings.name: Zomato Ltd

what_changed.text: June 2026 sales expanded to 20,211 crore rupees with net profit of 92 crore rupees.
The company obtained an ESG score of 76.00 in the Leader band for FY2026.
Reports surfaced indicating delivery platforms may face a 5% GST rate across business models.

holdings.why_it_matters: Representing 2.42% of the fund, Zomato contributed an estimated +0.282% over 3 months on an 11.67% share price rise.

watch.text: CBIC clarifications and implementation rules concerning the 5% GST on app-based delivery services.

holdings.name: BSE Ltd

what_changed.text: BSE posted sales of 1,566 crore rupees and net profit of 873 crore rupees in the June 2026 quarter.
The exchange scheduled institutional investor meetings with Blackrock, Westwood Global, and JP Morgan in late September 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: BSE carries a 2.40% portfolio weight and detracted an estimated -0.330% over 3 months following a 13.76% price decline.

watch.text: Trading volumes and transaction charges disclosures in upcoming quarterly reports.

holdings.name: REC Ltd

what_changed.text: REC incorporated three transmission subsidiaries on October 5, 2026 for projects in Bikaner and Mirzapur.
The company sold Balsane Power Transmission Ltd for 5.59 crore rupees on September 28, 2026.
Stock exchanges imposed fines on REC for board composition non-compliance during June 2026, for which it requested a waiver.

holdings.why_it_matters: With a 2.12% weight, REC reduced 3-month portfolio performance by an estimated -0.313% as its price dropped 14.76%.

watch.text: Exchanges' decisions on REC's fine waiver application for governance non-compliance.

holdings.name: ICICI Lombard General Insurance Company Ltd

what_changed.text: An appellate authority in Hyderabad confirmed a GST demand of 2.42 crore rupees and penalty of 2.64 crore rupees for FY18.
A Chennai appellate authority partially allowed an appeal, reducing a tax demand to 3,34,646 rupees on September 30, 2026.
The insurer scheduled its Q2 and H1 FY27 earnings call.

holdings.why_it_matters: Holding 2.06% of the portfolio, the insurer fell 7.45% over 3 months, despite a 14.67% recovery over the trailing 1 month.

watch.text: Underwriting metrics and claims commentary during the Q2 FY27 earnings call.

holdings.name: One 97 Communications Ltd

what_changed.text: Paytm raised its stake in Little Internet to 77.42% and invested 100 crore rupees into Paytm Money.
Shareholders approved 9 resolutions at the AGM, including IPO proceeds variation and remuneration items.
Shares faced volatility following reports of a likely deferment in the rollout of UPI MDR.

holdings.why_it_matters: With a 2.04% fund weight, Paytm generated an estimated +0.447% 3-month contribution after rallying 21.93%.

watch.text: Government and regulatory announcements regarding UPI MDR timelines.

portfolio.statement: Nippon India Growth Mid Cap Fund returned -5.13% over 3 months, weighed down by drops in healthcare and non-bank financials despite gains in capital market and consumer tech holdings.
interp: Top contributors like MCX (+19.76%) and Paytm (+21.93%) could not offset heavy corrections in Fortis Healthcare (-18.78%), REC (-14.76%), and BSE (-13.76%).
The fund maintains high exposure to Financials (28.7%), making performance vulnerable to divergence between exchanges, banks, and lending institutions.
portfolio.line: Gains in market infrastructure and consumer platforms were overshadowed by corrections in healthcare and state financiers.

drivers.text: Multi Commodity Exchange Of India contributed an estimated +0.636% as revenue expanded and leadership was reshuffled.
One 97 Communications provided an estimated +0.447% 3-month gain following subsidiary capital injections and AGM approvals.
